dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible in the posterior-dorsal quadrant are four distinct 'O' shaped structures. They feature irregular, high-contrast dark perimeters with a width of approximately 3-8 pixels, transitioning abruptly into light-tan interior cores. One 'C' shaped structure is positioned mid-laterally, exhibiting a break in the dark perimeter along its ventral edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, dark, asymmetrical clusters is present in the anterior dorsal region. These clusters consist of 10-25 pixel groupings of low-intensity values with no internal gradient, concentrated primarily along the transition zone between the brightly lit dorsal surface and the shaded lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four prominent posterior macro-annuli form an elongated, non-equilateral quadrilateral. Connecting the centroids of the anterior high-intensity blobs creates a dense network of interlocking triangles with high vertex angles oriented towards the rostrum.
